title: SIG/CAIQ Autopack Negotiation Assistant + Pricing Signal
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem statement: enterprise prospects submit SIG/CAIQ and other security questionnaires that are time-consuming to answer and gate contract velocity. Sales and legal currently triage these manually; customers with heavy attestation needs often require pricing credits or dedicated concierge support, but there is no consistent signal linking questionnaire complexity to a pricing or SLA offer.

Goal: build an 'Autopack Negotiation Assistant' — a tool that: (1) ingests a SIG/CAIQ response bundle, (2) generates a prepopulated canonical attestation package (signed template + evidence references), (3) produces a quantitative complexity score that maps to recommended commercial treatments (credit, concierge, SLA tier), and (4) surfaces negotiation language snippets for Legal to accelerate close.

Success metrics: reduce average RFP/case time-to-legal-complete from baseline by 30% in pilot accounts; reduce manual hours per questionnaire by 60% for Sales Ops; generate a predictive pricing signal that correctly aligns recommended treatment with final commercial outcome in 80% of pilot cases.

Scope decisions & trade-offs: we will start with SIG/CAIQ + top 10 vendor-supplied questionnaire formats (CSV/Excel/Word) and postpone free-form security questionnaires until V2. We evaluated two parsing approaches: (A) rules + heuristics (fast, explainable) and (B) ML extractor (more robust across formats). Chose hybrid: rules for standard SIG sections + lightweight ML for free-text answers. This balances speed of implementation vs. long-term accuracy.

Privacy & security: processed documents must not leave customer region for Private deployments. Implementation will use ephemeral KMS-wrapped keys and audit logs (ENG to implement KMS integration ticket ENG-2109 before production). Legal requested logging policy options; plan documented in Confluence (link below).

Rollout plan: 1) internal alpha with Sales Ops and Legal (2 weeks), 2) pilot with 5 high-touch enterprise customers (6 weeks), 3) iterate on scoring thresholds, then 4) expose as opt-in feature in Console with pricing trigger options (credits vs. fixed-fee vs. SLA uplift). Canary route will gate on a contract size > $100k ARR.

Deliverables: parsing microservice, scoring model (configurable thresholds), attestation template generator (PDF + signed JSON), negotiation snippet library (Legal-approved), pricing-signal mapping matrix, telemetry dashboard for time-to-complete and manual hours saved.
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff with Sales Ops + Legal. Gathered sample SIG/CAIQ bundles from 12 closed deals. Key pain: inconsistent evidence references and fragmented attachments.

2026-03-03: Eng sync — agreed hybrid parser approach. ENG to prototype ruleset and staging extractor by 2026-03-17. See RFC: https://confluence.redwood-inference.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=10432
2026-03-05: Design reviewed sample attestation PDF layout. DES feedback: add explicit evidence links page and 'confidence score' badges. Design task DES-287 created.

2026-03-07: Pricing workshop with Finance. Proposed three-commerce treatments: (A) 1-week manual review + $0 credit, (B) fastlane + 25% effort credit, (C) concierge + 100% credit + SLA. Finance requested pilot telemetry linking treatment to churn/expansion in 6 months.

2026-03-09: Legal feedback on negotiation snippets — require sentence-level versioning and link to master clause library. Legal requested approval flow before any snippet used in outbound communication. Created legal-review subtask PM-482910.

2026-03-11: Data/privacy review — Private deployments must process in-customer region. Security team flagged requirement for HSM-backed signing for attestation PDFs in regulated verticals. ENG-2109 prioritized.

2026-03-12: Product decision: pilot will use dynamic thresholding for scoring (initial thresholds conservative). Measurement dashboard prototype available: https://dashboards.internal.redwood-inference.com/d/attestations/pilot-summary?orgId=1
Open follow-ups: automate evidence collection from S3 connectors, surface per-question confidence to Sales, and add 'decline-to-answer' templates for tricky items.
